metadata.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025; independent centerline digitization by OpenRacetrackDB
notes: Southern loop with its western outer bend, inner return and full eastern straight. The operator identifies the 4.1 km Southern Loop; the full course plan separates paddock, karting and energy-road access, all excluded. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 4075.3 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved border rings. Elevation follows the approximately 79 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source trace and borders have too many unmatched cross-sections for safe lap reconstruction. Lap playback is unavailable. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.
